sloka: तत्रापि सन्ध्यामन्वास्य वासविः सहरीश्वरः ।किष्किन्धामभितो गृह्य रावणं पुनरागमत् ।। ७.३४.३२ ॥
transliteration: tatrāpi sandhyāmanvāsya vāsaviḥ saharīśvaraḥ ।kiṣkindhāmabhito gṛhya rāvaṇaṁ punarāgamat ।। 7.34.32 ॥

translations.english: Having performed his evening prayers there as well, Vali, the lord of monkeys, returned towards Kishkindha, still holding Ravana.
